task.name: Load_strike_truck
task.when: As each asset lead releases a packed transport group during Strike

resources.resource: Build Lead, loading crew, and enough runners for the active work areas

step.action: Accept only transport groups released by their responsible asset lead.
Count each accepted group against 📦 Truck_Load_Plan.
Move each group to the truck using enough people for controlled lifting.
Load each group in its printed order and position.
Secure each completed load section with the specified restraint.
Record every missing, damaged, substituted, or separately transported item on the load plan.
Have the Build Lead inspect weight distribution, restraint, door clearance, and the final inventory.
Close and latch the equipment-truck door after loading is complete.

passWhen.criterion: Every accepted transport group is recorded and loaded in its planned position.
Every load section is secured and every exception is recorded.
The Build Lead approved the final load and door clearance.
The truck is closed and latched.
